run_export_data: run the export_data script to export approved Mephisto task units to the dataset checkpoint location
extract_final_data: create a function that converts Mephisto-formatted inputs and outputs into a final annotation dict with captions and mask data
refactor_extract_final_data: refactor extract_final_data to merge mask data from outputs into inputs and return structured annotation fields
review_main: review the main function that queries LocalMephistoDB for approved units and exports images and JSON annotations
summarize_export_data: summarize the export_data script that copies source images and writes formatted annotation JSON files for approved crowdwork units
